paragraphs: R' Abba bar Yudan, Vayikra Rabbah 4:2; Kahana bar Yudan, Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:14.
R' Tanchum bar Yudan, Berakhot, chapter 6, halakhah 1.[^1]

notes.text: ויק״ר/שהש״ר are contextually Vayikra Rabbah/Shir HaShirim Rabbah; פ״ד-ב/פ״ו-יד give 4:2/6:14 as source locators, without verified modern correspondence. Berakhot 6h 1 does not name the Talmud corpus; Jerusalem Talmud remains a contextual suggestion. The three bar-Yudan attestations do not establish a single father. Kahana remains untitled, while Abba and Tanchum remain R'.
